Title: Verify that the Employee List displays the expected employee fields
Preconditions:
The user is logged in to OrangeHRM and has permission to view the Employee List.
Employee ID 0562 exists in the system.
Test Data:
Employee ID: 0562
First Name: Archana
Last Name: Suresh
Steps:
1. Open the PIM module.
2. Select Employee List.
3. Verify the displayed column headers.
4. Locate employee ID 0562 in the displayed list.
5. Verify that employee ID 0562 is displayed with the correct name.
Expected Result:
The Employee List displays the expected fields: Id, First (& Middle) Name, Last Name, Job Title, Employment Status, Sub Unit, Supervisor, and Actions.

Employee ID 0562 is displayed with the name Archana Suresh.
Actual Result: The Employee List displayed all expected fields, and employee ID 0562 was displayed with the name Archana Suresh.

Title: Verify that opening an individual employee's profile displays the expected information
Preconditions: The user is logged in and has permission to view employee profiles.
Test Data:
Employee ID: 0562
Employee Name: Archana Suresh
Steps:
1. Open the Employee List.
2. Locate employee ID 0562.
3. Click the Edit icon in the Actions column.
4. Review the employee information displayed in the profile.
Expected Result: The employee profile opens successfully and displays the correct employee information, including the Employee ID, first name, last name, and other available details.
Actual Result: The employee profile opened successfully and displayed the expected employee information for employee ID 0562.

Title: Verify that the Employee List supports pagination when there are many records
Preconditions: The user is logged in and is on the Employee List page. The list contains more than one page of records.
Steps:
1. Scroll to the bottom of the Employee List.
2. Click the Next Page button.
3. Verify that the next set of employee records is displayed.
4. Click the Previous Page button.
5. Verify that the previous set of employee records is displayed.
Expected Result: The Employee List allows the user to navigate between pages, and the correct employee records are displayed on each page without duplication or missing records.
Actual Result: The Employee List successfully displayed the next and previous pages, and the employee records were displayed correctly.

Title: Verify that a new employee can be added with the required information
Preconditions:
The user is logged in and is on the Employee List page.
The user has permission to add a new employee.
Test Data:
First Name: Lna
Middle Name: Ziad
Last Name: Alshebli
Employee ID: 0207
Steps:
1. Click the Add button.
2. Enter the required employee information.
3. Click Save.
Expected Result: The employee is added successfully, and the system opens the employee profile displaying the name “Lna Ziad Alshebli” and Employee ID “0207”.
Actual Result: The employee was added successfully, and the system opened the employee profile page displaying the employee name "Lna Ziad Alshebli" and Employee ID "0207".

Title: Verify that the system handles adding an employee with a duplicate Employee ID
Preconditions: The user is logged in and is on the Employee List page. Employee ID 0207 already exists in the system.
Test Data:
First Name: Ala'a
Middle Name: Ahmad
Last Name: Omari
Employee ID: 0207
Steps:
1. Click the Add button.
2. Enter the employee's required information.
3. Enter the existing Employee ID 0207.
4. Click Save.
Expected Result: The employee is not saved, and the message “Employee Id already exists” is displayed under the Employee Id field.
Actual Result: The system prevented the employee from being saved and displayed the validation message "Employee Id already exists" under the Employee Id field.

Title: Verify that entered data is not saved when the user cancels the Add Employee form
Preconditions: The user is logged in and is on the Add Employee page.
Test Data:
First Name: Ala'a
Middle Name: Ahmad
Last Name: Omari
Employee ID: 0204
Steps:
1. Enter the employee's required information.
2. Click Cancel.
3. Open the Employee List.
4. Search for Employee ID 0204 or the employee name.
Expected Result: The entered data is discarded, the Add Employee form is closed, and the employee is not displayed in the Employee List.
Actual Result: The entered employee data was discarded after clicking Cancel, and the employee was not displayed in the Employee List.

Title: Verify that the system navigates to the newly created employee's profile after successful creation
Preconditions: The user is logged in and is on the Add Employee page.
Test Data:
First Name: Omar
Middle Name: A
Last Name: Saleh
Employee ID: 0101
Steps:
1. Enter the required employee information.
2. Click Save.
3. Observe the page displayed after the employee is saved.
Expected Result: The employee is added successfully, and the system navigates the user to the newly created employee's profile page.
Actual Result: The employee was added successfully, and the system navigated the user to the newly created employee's profile page displaying the employee name "Omar A Saleh" and Employee ID "0101".

Title: Verify that the system displays validation errors when required employee information is missing
Preconditions: The user is logged in and is on the Add Employee page.
Test Data:
First Name: Empty
Middle Name: Empty
Last Name: Empty
Employee ID: 0102
Steps:
1. Leave the First Name and Last Name fields empty.
2. Enter Employee ID 0102.
3. Click Save.
Expected Result: The employee is not saved, and the message “Required” is displayed under the First Name and Last Name fields.
Actual Result: The system prevented the employee from being saved and displayed the validation message "Required" under the First Name and Last Name fields.

Title: Verify that authorized users can edit existing employee information
Preconditions:
The user is logged in and is on the Employee List page.
Employee ID 0562 exists in the list.
Test Data:
Employee ID: 0562
Current First Name: Archana
Updated First Name: Archana Test
Steps:
1. Locate employee ID 0562 in the Employee List.
2. Click the Edit icon.
3. Change the First Name from "Archana" to "Archana Test".
4. Click Save.
5. Verify that the updated name is displayed.
Expected Result: The employee information is updated successfully, and the updated details are displayed in the employee profile or Employee List.
Actual Result: The employee's first name was updated successfully from "Archana" to "Archana Test", and the updated name was displayed.

Employee ID 0562 exists in the system.

Title: Verify that the search is not case-sensitive
Preconditions:
The user is logged in and is on the Employee List page.
The employee "Lna Ziad Alshebli" exists in the system.
Steps:
1. Enter "LNA" in the Employee Name field.
2. Click Search.
3. Check the search result.
Expected Result: The search displays the employee “Lna Ziad Alshebli”, the same result as searching with “Lna”.
Actual Result: The employee Lna Ziad Alshebli was displayed when searching with "LNA", as it was with "Lna".
